PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_3 E2E Runner And Snapshots
PHASE.GOAL: Implement TOML scenario execution and golden snapshot comparison for full-cycle command output verification.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Scenario TOML selects a fixture, runs ordered steps, validates expectations, and emits a bounded result.
Snapshot command steps normalize command output before comparing with golden files.

STEPS.step-1: Implement snapshot create, compare, update, normalization, and summary logic.
STEPS.step-2: Implement E2E scenario model and command/write_file/snapshot step executor.
STEPS.step-3: Wire syn test e2e and syn test snapshot CLI handlers.
STEPS.step-4: Add full-cycle scenario fixture and failure scenario coverage.

RISKS.RISK: Snapshots will be flaky if paths, timings, versions, ANSI, or IDs are not normalized.
